narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On September 24, 2024, at approximately 0505 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered two men walking along a county road near Allegan, Michigan. Both stated that they are citizens of Mexico without documents. This record concerns one of the two men; the other is documented separately.
ENTRY:
[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stated that he crossed the border near Douglas, Arizona, in July 2012, by walking through the desert.
[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stated that he crossed near Douglas in 2016 with a cousin.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Both men were processed for Notices to Appear.
